tests.name: test_omnidexer_state_machine
marks: pytest.mark.skip(reason='Omnidexer implementation details not suitable for stateful testing')

tests.name: test_bulk_operations_consistency
marks: given(st.lists(st.text(min_size=1, max_size=20), min_size=1, max_size=10), st.integers(min_value=1, max_value=100))

tests.name: test_classic_spell_examples
marks: example(spell_data={'name': 'Test Spell', 'source': 'SRD', 'level': 3, 'school': 'V', 'time': [{'number': 1, 'unit': 'action'}], 'range': {'type': 'point', 'distance': {'type': 'feet', 'amount': 150}}, 'components': {'v': True, 's': True, 'm': 'a focus crystal'}, 'duration': [{'type': 'instant'}], 'entries': ['A magical effect emanates from your focus...']})

tests.name: test_progress_tracker_rich_style
marks: pytest.mark.skipif(not RICH_AVAILABLE, reason='Rich library not available')

tests.name: test_get_spell_attack_text_parametrized
marks: pytest.mark.parametrize('spell_modifications,expected_attack_text', [({'savingThrow': ['dexterity']}, 'Dexterity saving throw'), ({'spellAttack': ['ranged']}, 'ranged spell attack'), ({'spellAttack': ['melee']}, 'melee spell attack'), ({}, ''), ({'savingThrow': ['dexterity', 'constitution']}, 'Dexterity, Constitution saving throw')])

tests.name: test_get_enhanced_level_text_parametrized
marks: pytest.mark.parametrize('level,school,damage_types,attack_info,expected_text', [(3, 'V', ['fire'], {'savingThrow': ['dexterity']}, '3rd-level evocation (fire damage, Dexterity saving throw)'), (0, 'V', ['force'], {'spellAttack': ['ranged']}, 'Evocation cantrip (force damage, ranged spell attack)'), (1, 'E', None, {}, '1st-level enchantment'), (9, 'N', ['necrotic', 'psychic'], {'savingThrow': ['constitution']}, '9th-level necromancy (necrotic, psychic damage, Constitution saving throw)')])

tests.name: test_get_enhanced_components_text_parametrized
marks: pytest.mark.parametrize('components,expected_text', [({'v': True, 's': True, 'm': {'text': 'a tiny ball of bat guano'}}, 'V, S, M (a tiny ball of bat guano)'), ({'v': True, 's': True}, 'V, S'), ({'v': True}, 'V'), ({'s': True}, 'S'), ({'m': {'text': 'a diamond worth 1,000 gp'}}, 'M (a diamond worth 1,000 gp)'), ({'v': True, 'm': {'text': 'a feather'}}, 'V, M (a feather)')])

tests.name: test_complete_spell_formatting_integration
marks: pytest.mark.parametrize('spell_name,level,school,components,damage_types,conditions,area_tags,attack_info', [('Fireball', 3, 'V', {'v': True, 's': True, 'm': {'text': 'bat guano'}}, ['fire'], None, ['S'], {'savingThrow': ['dexterity']}), ('Hold Person', 2, 'E', {'v': True, 's': True, 'm': {'text': 'iron piece'}}, None, ['paralyzed'], None, {'savingThrow': ['wisdom']}), ('Eldritch Blast', 0, 'V', {'v': True, 's': True}, ['force'], None, None, {'spellAttack': ['ranged']})])

tests.name: test_various_input_formats
marks: pytest.mark.parametrize('input_abbrev,expected_match', [('cos', True), ('COS', True), ('CoS', True), ('  cos  ', True), ('xyz', False), ('', False)])
